profile.geoLocationName: New York, New York, United States
profile.summary: Senior Associate at KPMG specializing in automation, data engineering, and control testing within financial services. Experienced in executing testing procedures for model risk, operational and SOX controls, while also developing Generative AI and intelligent automation solutions that streamline evidence gathering, enhance testing accuracy, and improve overall control efficiency. Combines strong analytical and audit expertise with technical proficiency in Azure, Power Platform, Databricks, and Python.

volunteerExperiences.description:
- Advise two high-achieving high-school students from low-income families throughout their college application process.
- Mentor students 5-6 hours per week for four sequential semesters to build a sustainable solution to college access in America.
- Facilitate feedback on college essays and college lists while coaching students on interview skills.

organizations.name: Puerto Rican Student Association of Notre Dame (PRSAND)
organizations.description:
• Proposed and initiated a club for Puerto Ricans at Notre Dame where over 40 graduate and undergraduate students participate in cultural activities to build the PR community within campus
• Collected over $1,000 in a series of fundraisers for an emergency relief fund following the earthquakes
in PR at the beginning of 2020
• Started “El Calenton”, a podcast co-sponsored by NDtv to increase awareness in the local community
regarding Puerto Rican issues; currently heading into the fourth season of the podcast
• Hosted three virtual speakers in a “Puerto Rican Week” with panel discussions on climate change in PR,
PR’s status quo, and Gender Violence within the island to educate ND faculty and students
